title.narrative: Aufbau von Kapazitäten in der ökologischen Landwirtschaft und Lobbyarbeit in Sri Lanka
Organic agriculture capacity building and advocacy in Sri Lanka

Sri Lanka is experiencing an economic and food crisis due to the consequences of the coronavirus pandemic, declining tourism, mismanagement and very high national debt, which leaves the government little room for manoeuvre. As a result, fertiliser and pesticide imports can no longer be subsidised to the usual extent and are lacking in agriculture. LOAM is addressing this situation by supporting smallholder farmers in particular in their transition to agroecological farming. To this end, advisory and training capacities in the field of organic farming are also being created at the state level.
